title: Configure AI Service Integration and Environment Setup
description: Set up the external AI service integration by obtaining API credentials, installing required dependencies, and configuring secure environment variable management for the OpenAI API key.
details: Install the OpenAI SDK (`npm install openai`) and configure environment variables for secure API key storage. Create `.env.local` file with OPENAI_API_KEY variable for local development and ensure it's properly gitignored. Set up the OpenAI client initialization in the backend with proper error handling for missing credentials. This foundation is critical for all subsequent AI-powered functionality.
test_strategy: Verify environment variable loading, test OpenAI client initialization, and validate that API key is properly secured and not exposed in client-side code. Create unit tests for client configuration.

title: Implement AI Chat API Backend Logic
description: Develop the core backend functionality in `/api/chat/route.ts` to handle user messages, construct AI prompts with user context, and integrate with OpenAI's GPT-4 for schedule auditing responses.
details: Implement the POST handler in `app/api/chat/route.ts` using Vercel AI SDK and OpenAI integration. Design prompts that include user schedule context from the database to provide personalized auditing. Implement streaming responses for real-time user feedback. Add proper error handling for API failures, rate limits, and content moderation. Include input validation and sanitization to prevent prompt injection attacks.
test_strategy: Create integration tests that mock OpenAI responses to validate request/response flow. Test error handling scenarios including API failures and rate limits. Verify prompt construction and user context integration.

title: Build Chat Interface Components
description: Create the conversational UI components using assistant-ui and shadcn/ui to enable users to interact with the AI schedule auditor through a chat interface on the dashboard.
details: Implement chat UI components using `assistant-ui` and `@ai-sdk/react` hooks in the dashboard. Create message bubbles, input field, and streaming response handling. Integrate with the `/api/chat` endpoint using proper state management for chat history. Ensure responsive design and accessibility compliance. Add loading states and error handling for failed API calls.
test_strategy: Test chat component rendering, message state management, and streaming response handling. Verify accessibility features and responsive design across different screen sizes. Create end-to-end tests for user chat interactions.

title: Integrate Chat Interface with Dashboard
description: Integrate the chat interface into the main dashboard page and ensure seamless user experience with proper authentication context and user data access.
details: Modify `app/dashboard/page.tsx` to include the chat interface alongside existing dashboard components. Ensure proper authentication context is available for personalized AI responses. Implement user session data integration to provide relevant schedule context to the AI. Add proper layout and styling to maintain dashboard design consistency using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.
test_strategy: Test dashboard integration with authenticated users, verify chat functionality within dashboard context, and ensure proper user data access. Test layout responsiveness and component interaction.

title: Implement Chat History Storage and Retrieval
description: Add database functionality to store and retrieve chat conversation history, enabling persistent conversations and improved user experience across sessions.
details: Extend the existing database schema to include chat message storage using Drizzle ORM. Implement functions to save user messages and AI responses to the `chat_messages` table. Add retrieval logic to load conversation history when users return to the dashboard. Ensure proper user association and data privacy. Implement conversation management features like clearing history or starting new conversations.
test_strategy: Test database operations for storing and retrieving chat messages. Verify user data isolation and privacy. Test conversation persistence across user sessions and proper cleanup functionality.
